contact.evidence_quote: Residents at Concordia Village in Springfield, Illinois also love playing water volleyball. A favorite event is a Residents vs. Staff game where residents and Concordia Village staff members play against each other. Everyone wins because afterwards they all enjoy ice cream. “A lot of our residents are athletic. We had one resident who went to the Senior Olympics in Arizona for track,” said Greta Huseman, Director of Lifestyle Enrichment for Concordia Village.
